info.name: Backend API
info.description:
The backend's HTTP APIs: the player API (platform, /v1/...) and the operator's admin API.
Run in order: it is one scenario, and each request keeps in the collection's variables what later ones need.
Set baseUrl (the platform, or https://<name> through nginx), adminUrl and adminToken first.
Reference: docs/api/ in the repository. The lobby WebSocket is not in a collection (Postman cannot export WebSocket requests): docs/api/02-lobby-websocket.md.

item.name: 00 Health
item.description: The platform answers. Not reachable through nginx (only /v1/ and /lobby are proxied).

item.name: 01 Accounts and sessions
item.description: Three players for the rest of the run (A, B, C), with names unique to this run, and a guest. Every register, login, guest creation, guest login and upgrade counts against 30 a minute per address (429 too_many_attempts with Retry-After), and password logins against 10 per username per 15 minutes. This folder makes 11 such calls.

exec: // Names unique to this run: base36 of the time.

item.name: Register player C (no display name: the username is used)
Log in as the guest, by its key
Upgrade the guest to an account
Rename A again: once in 30 days (429)
A token that is not a session (401 invalid_session)
02 Content
item.description: Public, no token. Each answer carries an ETag; sent back as If-None-Match it is 304 with no body.

item.name: 03 Shop, payments, inventory, equipment, boosts, pass
item.description: A new account has 0 coins and 0 gems. Gems come from a simulated payment here (the platform must run with BACKEND_PAYMENT_PROVIDER=simulated, or every /v1/payments route is 503 payments_off); a first paid order is doubled, so gems_500 gives 1000. Coins come only from playing: a coin offer is 409 insufficient_funds.

item.name: Simulate again: no longer pending (confirmed false)
The same purchase retried: already_bought, nothing taken
Buy a coin offer without coins (409)
04 Progress, seasons, boards
item.description: Score boards fill from match results; rating boards list a player after 10 rated matches in the mode, so /me is 404 not_ranked for a new player.

item.name: My place on a board: not ranked yet (404)
05 Party
item.description: A party is made by its leader's first invitation (at most 3; an invitation lives 60 s). Members are pushed evt.party.* on the lobby.

item.name: A says a phrase to the party
A says another at once: one every two seconds (429)
A kicks B: the party of one ends
06 Friends, blocks, inbox
item.description: A asks B; B accepts by asking back. Each ask counts against 20 an hour.

item.name: A ends the friendship with B
07 Teams
item.description: A makes a team, invites B, C applies and is accepted. Leaving, removal and disbanding start a 24-hour cooldown, and names are unique however they are cased or accented: each run uses fresh players and a name with the run in it.

item.name: A makes B a vice leader
A hands the team to B
08 Matchmaking
item.description: A seat in the public arena; a queue; a sandbox. Each grant is the arena's address and a single-use ticket for 60 seconds, which the client presents to the arena over its own TCP protocol (docs/detailed-design/02-networking.md). The matcher matches only players connected to the lobby WebSocket: each round (about a second) it drops anyone queued without a connection, whose state becomes none. So over HTTP alone a player can queue, but not be matched; the whole duel, from the queue to the grant, is in docs/api/lobby-example.mjs.

item.name: A seat in the public arena
A: queue status (queued, or none once the matcher has dropped A for having no lobby connection)
A accepts a match it was not asked about (409)
09 Admin API (a test stack only: it broadcasts, closes a room, bans this run's player C)
item.description: The operator's API: platform's second listener, on loopback only (BACKEND_ADMIN_ADDR, reached over SSH), with Authorization: Bearer <the admin secret>. Every change needs a reason, and every call is audited in MySQL. Not for production as it stands: the notice goes to every connected player and the room close kicks a real room.

exec: if (body && body.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('arenaName', body[0].arena); pm.collectionVariables.set('roomName', body[0].room); }

item.name: Players by day, and who came back

exec: // Registration open for two hours from now, the first round five minutes after.

item.name: Kick player C from every arena
Suspend player C for a day
C cannot log in while suspended (403)
A orders again while owing the refund's gems (409)
Close a room (its players are kicked)
10 Tournaments
item.description: Made by an operator (09). A player needs 10 rated matches in the mode to register: a new one is 409 too_few_rated.

item.name: 12 Admin: end the season (a test stack only)
item.description: Ends the current season now; the worker places, pays and resets it within the minute. Last, since the pass and the boards change with it.
